Thank you for your enquiry about buildings insurance for 101 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 1ZZ. To approach Northmere Mutual for a landlord quotation, could you confirm the following:

1. Ownership/tenure: is the flat leasehold or freehold, and is buildings cover already provided by a freeholder's/management company block policy? (If so, you may only need contents/landlord liability — please send a copy of the block policy schedule if you have it.)
2. Property details: year built, construction type (walls and roof), number of storeys in the building and which floor the flat is on, number of bedrooms, and total number of flats in the building.
3. Sum insured / rebuild cost for the flat (or your lease's share), plus any landlord's contents, fixtures and fittings you want covered.
4. Letting details: intended tenancy type (e.g. AST), tenant type (working professionals, students, DSS, etc.), expected start date of the letting, and whether the property will be unoccupied or unfurnished before letting.
5. Risk details: any flood, subsidence or storm history at the property; any previous claims in the last 5 years; any unspent criminal convictions or previous insurance declined/cancelled.
6. Security: locks on final exit doors, smoke/heat alarms, and whether there is a gas safety certificate and EICR in place.
7. Cover options you'd like quoted: e.g. accidental damage, loss of rent, landlord liability limit, legal expenses, home emergency.
8. Your full name, correspondence address, date of birth and contact number for the quotation.

Once I have these I will request a quotation from Northmere Mutual. Please note any figures they provide will be subject to their terms, validation and acceptance — I cannot confirm price or cover until they respond.
